articles.summary: Experienced private markets investor joins StepStone following a decade at Japan’s Government Pension Investment Fund StepStone Group Inc. (Nasdaq: STEP), a leading global private markets investment firm, today announced that Yoshitaka Todoroki has joined the firm as a Vice Chairman, focusing on strategic initiatives in Japan and the broader Asia region.
